use_case_summary: Customer is an SMB retail-tech company running chat-based support widget + on-site FAQ search. Wants hosted API for quick rollout. Primary constraints: perceived latency for EU users, limited budget for tokens, simple team (SE + product) to manage integration.
latency_targets: p95 end-to-end render <= 1s for chat snips; p95 generation <= 800ms ideally. Acceptable cold-starts up to 1.5s during promotional bursts.
model_preferences: prefer smaller low-latency variants; willing to test Redwood curated open models and quantized options. Consider fallback to higher-quality hosted models for rare cases.
prompt_guidance: Keep prompts under ~600 tokens for chat to avoid long generation times
Use system + short user context; offload long docs to embeddings retrieval rather than concatenating into prompt
Enable streaming on client to improve perceived latency — render tokens as they arrive
Use caching for repeated FAQ responses (prefix caching enabled)
region_recommendation: Enable region pinning to eu-west-1 for EU users and us-west-2 for West Coast US. Suggest routing policy: geo-IP client routing + fallback to nearest region. Offer trial nodes in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
timeout_recommendation: Client request timeout 10s for normal chat; set server-side token-generation timeout at 12s. Implement client retry with linear backoff (1s, 2s) for idempotent queries.
se_notes: Quick wins recommended: region pinning, reduce prompt length, enable streaming, and set client-side timeouts. Follow-up demo to show region traffic split dashboard and p95 lat metrics.
